title: THE BURN LEDGER
lede: Not Cognition's history — the operator's. This is the local accounting of one user's Devin usage: every assistant turn, every model, every project, pulled straight from the sessions database on this machine.
body:
h2. THE TOP LINE

table(statrow).
|6.36B|61,494|661|9|
|tokens burned|assistant turns|sessions|days on record|

p. Nine days of local Devin CLI/Desktop telemetry — every assistant turn in every session, deduplicated by message key the same way "otter-stats":https://github.com/chris-wozniczek/otter-stats does it. The window is 2026-10-07 to 2026-10-15; the peak was %(ok)2026-10-10% at *1.43B tokens in a single day*.
